card: Is it just me? | One period after “ok” and I reread the whole chat.
Have you been mogged? | Nina joined the group photo. Everyone stood up straighter. You’ve been asked to hold the camera.
Your friend’s mom said “Love you.” Worse reply? | “Bet.” or “Thanks so much.”
Would you do the same? | You planned your main character return all summer. New jacket. New walk. Ben asks if you’re new.
Is it just me? | Someone asked if the mug is microwave safe. You answered. You don’t work there or own the mug.
Have you been mogged? | Your own mom asks how Nina’s doing before she asks about you. You’ve been mogged at home.
Have you done this? | Last slice. Someone behind you. “Oh, I already had some!” You did not have some.
Would you do the same? | The usher said, “Enjoy the movie.” You said, “You too.” So you bought him a ticket.
Whose job is this? | The project is due at 8 a.m. You opened the shared doc. It says “hey guys.” That’s it. We’re cooked.
Would you admit it? | A stranger told you to touch grass. You went out to prove a point. It was nice. You’re furious.
Is it just me? | The group chat moves on while I’m perfecting my joke.
Have you done this? | You rang the bus bell too early. You got off so it wouldn’t be weird. You get off there every day.
Do you say it was yours? | You told a joke. Nothing. Kofi said it louder. Huge laugh. You got mogged with your own material.
Translate: | Haha that’s crazy.
Dear diary, | Nadia got the A you wanted. You said, “So proud of you.” You lowkey asked to see the rubric.
Have you done this? | You said “Working hard or hardly working?” in the break room. Chat, you’ve become an NPC.
Is it just me? | Rereading my text after it’s sent, in their voice.
Scarier text from your boss? | Got a minute? or Per my last email.
Worse text from a friend? | Don’t look at the group chat. or Have you looked at the group chat?
Too late to ask? | Who’s the unsaved number in the group chat? It’s been a year.
Dear diary, | Sent it to the wrong chat. It was about the chat.
Is it just me? | Doing a little jog in the crosswalk to show the car I care.
Did it happen? | You sank a paper ball from across the room. Nobody saw. You told Mom. That’s not how aura works.
Are they mad at you? | Haha okay.
What did she mean? | You played Hana your song. There was a pause. She said, “So many chords.”
Is this you? | You talked mulch with Theo’s parents for an hour. They ask for you. Your rizz only works on parents.
Dear diary, | I’ve checked who viewed my story more times than it has views.
Is this you? | You got the ick from a guy running for the bus. You’ve run for that bus. You have the ick for you.
Do you write the pass? | You wore a blazer to present. A freshman asked you for a hall pass. It’s giving substitute.
Translate: | Totally up to you!
Dear diary, | I added “lol” so it wouldn’t sound like I meant it.
Do you hold the door? | It’s someone whose text you’ve ignored since Tuesday.
Dear diary, | We both started typing. We both stopped. That was in June.
Friendly or a threat? | Your brother was in my class, too.
Is this you? | The Wi-Fi dropped for nine seconds. You’ve crashed out. You’re writing to the mayor.
Send it? | I’m fine lol
Colder text? | K. or Noted.
More annoying in a group chat? | Typing for nine minutes, then “ok.” or Answering a three-day-old question.
The more threatening fridge note? | Whoever ate my yogurt: I know. or Whoever ate my yogurt: enjoy it.
Have you done this? | You said “What?” twice. A third felt rude. So you nodded. You now co-own a boat.
Your group chat joke got nothing. Then what? | Type “anyway.” or Let it scroll away.
Dear diary, | I left them on read so it wouldn’t look like I was waiting.
Have you done this? | You told the barber you loved it. You did not. You’ve had that haircut for eleven years.
Would you do the same? | Your friend told you to touch grass. You’ve put it on your calendar. Twenty minutes, Thursday.
Who texts first? | “Saturday?” “Bet.” “Bet.” “Bet.” Saturday came. Nobody ever said where, when or what.
Dear diary, | My friend proofread my text. The text was “sounds good.”
Can you save this? | You stretched in math. Your hand went up. Mr. Osei said, “Yes?” You said “Canada.” You’re cooked.
Compliment or insult? | You text like someone writing home from a ship.
Colder group chat move? | Leaving without a word. or A thumbs-up on a very long message.
Dear diary, | Whose turn is it to text first? I scrolled up to check.
Have you done this? | Sent it to the wrong group chat. Now you pass that group in the hall. Kevin gives a thumbs up.
Is it just me? | I pretend to text when I don’t know where to stand.
Have you done this? | Everyone’s quoting the movie. You’ve never seen it. You quoted it back. Wrong scene.
Dear diary, | I acted surprised about a trip I’d seen every photo of.
Your text sounds mad. What do you add? | An exclamation point. or “Haha,” for no reason.
Would you do the same? | You scored once in gym class. You’ve started practicing how to stay humble. Delulu.
Have you done this? | You tripped on nothing. You turned and glared at the sidewalk. You’ve filed a report with the city.
Are they mad at you? | Seen, 9:14 p.m. It is now Thursday.
Dear diary, 2:14 a.m. | You searched your own name in the group chat. Just to check. Weekly. You’re the red flag.
Have you done this? | You told everyone the movie was mid. You cried in the car. You’ve gone back, to be sure.
Which laugh isn’t laughing? | Ha. or Haha, wow.
Did you clap? | The sub said every name on the roster right. Every one. Nobody breathed. He ate.
What did they mean? | You declined their call: “so tired!!” Ten minutes later they post: “so bored lol.”
Is it still true? | “Best taco of my life, no cap.” You said that Tuesday. And Monday. Your friends are numbering them.
Finish the story? | You were halfway through your best story. The fries came. Nobody’s looked up. Mogged by fries.
Have you done this? | The group chat says “call me.” You pick up with “I know. I KNOW.” You know nothing.
Scarier punctuation in a text? | Okay. or Okay...
Is it hereditary? | Every drive, Dad says, “That used to be a bank.” Today you said it first. NPC runs in the family.
Dear diary, | Said “no worries” about the hoodie I lent out. It’s been 41 days. I have a spreadsheet.
